nodes.name: Manual isolated test
nodes.notes: Whole-workflow isolated entry only. Verify separate test destinations before execution.

nodes.name: Poll inactive
nodes.notes: 60-second schedule, inactive until reviewed owner manual adoption.

nodes.name: Read control
nodes.notes: Read singleton workflow interlock; this does not own the runner task slot.

nodes.name: Validate entry
nodes.notes: Validate exactly one well-typed global row. Unknown control state stops.

nodes.name: Already held
nodes.notes: Skip work if another execution holds the guard; never expire or reset it.

nodes.name: Report existing hold

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'skipped_held', control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report diagnostic hold without clearing it.

nodes.name: Prepare acquisition
nodes.notes: Capture execution ID and time for compare-and-set acquisition.

nodes.name: Acquire control
nodes.notes: Acquire idle guard conditionally; requires production workflow concurrency=1.

nodes.name: Check acquire receipt
nodes.notes: Verify typed acquisition response before external work.

nodes.name: Read acquired control
nodes.notes: Read persisted singleton rather than trusting write acknowledgement alone.

nodes.name: Verify acquisition
nodes.notes: Require exact guard ownership before calls or mutations.

nodes.name: Require acknowledged completion
nodes.notes: Only acknowledged submission/collection or no-work can release workflow guard.

nodes.name: Read before release
nodes.notes: Read singleton again to prevent releasing another execution.

nodes.name: Verify release ownership
nodes.notes: Check execution, time and completed issue context before clearing busy.

nodes.name: Release control
nodes.notes: Clear workflow busy only. Runner slot release requires separate stopped/publication proof.

nodes.name: Check release receipt
nodes.notes: Require busy=false with unchanged diagnostic ownership.

nodes.name: Read released control
nodes.notes: Read persistence to confirm guard release.

nodes.name: Confirm idle
nodes.notes: Fail closed if persisted idle state differs from acknowledgement.

nodes.name: Report completion

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'released', outcome:$('Require acknowledged completion').first().json.outcome, control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report bounded orchestration completion, never infer agent completion from guard release.

nodes.name: No work
nodes.notes: Release only this execution guard; durable runner reservation remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Read runner slot
nodes.notes: Authenticated durable slot read. A nonempty slot prevents selection even when Building labels disappear.

nodes.name: Validate slot
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Slot empty
nodes.notes: Occupied/held runner slot releases this short guard as no-work, never expires the task reservation.

nodes.name: Read continuation queue
nodes.notes: Read durable unconsumed question claims. Only released scoped answers get priority; a free-slot check always precedes this read.

nodes.name: Validate continuation queue
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Discover all issues
nodes.notes: Read all issues, including closed/non-owner Building conflicts. Orphan Building blocks empty-ledger selection.

nodes.name: Read queue events
nodes.notes: Read complete repository issue label history to order initial approvals by Approved-entry time then issue number. Derived priority is added in later stories.

nodes.name: Select candidate
nodes.notes: Orphan Building holds. Choose answered tasks before ordinary approvals, then Approved-entry time and issue number. A live slot is never preempted.

nodes.name: Have candidate
nodes.notes: No eligible task releases workflow guard; otherwise read complete approval history.

nodes.name: Read approval events
nodes.notes: Read all label history. Owner actor alone cannot turn factory protocol into initial approval.

nodes.name: Read approved comments
nodes.notes: Read complete refinement, captured source and marked prior attempts. Edits/ambiguity stop.

nodes.name: Read main base
nodes.notes: Capture exact main SHA for immutable input; runner rechecks before preparing worktree.

nodes.name: Freeze approved input
nodes.notes: Freeze criteria, constraints, discussion, source hashes and deterministic authorization UUID. Model identifier maps to an owner allowlisted private config; no caller-selected model.

nodes.name: Set issue context
nodes.notes: Set selected issue diagnostic only while this execution owns the workflow guard.

nodes.name: Check issue context
nodes.notes: Read update receipt and verify exact execution/issue ownership before writes.

nodes.name: Reserve runner
nodes.notes: Commit singleton reservation before Building. Same UUID/payload replays; conflicts never replace another task.

nodes.name: Validate reservation
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Prepare attempt journal
nodes.notes: Validate committed immutable hash/status; completed or previously dispatched attempts cannot be resubmitted as new.

nodes.name: Journal Building
nodes.notes: Journal intent or confirm exact external evidence. Conflicts/unknown writes hold guard and durable slot.

nodes.name: Journal Building receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Add Building
nodes.notes: Add target before removing Approved. No automatic retry on unknown response.

nodes.name: Check Building
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Remove Approved
nodes.notes: Remove only approved label after confirmed Building addition, retaining unrelated labels.

nodes.name: Check Approved removal
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read Building issue
nodes.notes: Read back open owner-authored sole Building before journal confirmation or launch.

nodes.name: Verify Building
nodes.notes: A receipt alone is insufficient. Confirm persisted issue state. Runner will independently revalidate source.

nodes.name: Confirm Building
nodes.notes: Journal intent or confirm exact external evidence. Conflicts/unknown writes hold guard and durable slot.

nodes.name: Confirm Building receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Journal attempt marker
nodes.notes: Journal intent or confirm exact external evidence. Conflicts/unknown writes hold guard and durable slot.

nodes.name: Journal attempt marker receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Post attempt marker
nodes.notes: Post one v2 attempt marker using orchestrator credential. Lost response holds without repeat POST.

nodes.name: Check attempt marker
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Verify marker receipt
nodes.notes: Validate owner-token actor AND exact runner-bound marker content. This comment never grants approval.

nodes.name: Confirm attempt marker
nodes.notes: Journal intent or confirm exact external evidence. Conflicts/unknown writes hold guard and durable slot.

nodes.name: Confirm attempt marker receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read Building events
nodes.notes: Re-read approval/removal lineage before start; changes stop.

nodes.name: Read Building comments
nodes.notes: Re-read marker and source to detect edits/deletions before accepted start.

nodes.name: Final Building issue
nodes.notes: Fresh issue read immediately before acceptance, after marker readback.

nodes.name: Verify launch snapshot
nodes.notes: Require unchanged approved source plus exact marker readback. Building precedes asynchronous submission.

nodes.name: Start attempt
nodes.notes: Bounded authenticated acceptance, never wait for Codex. Unknown acknowledgement retains same UUID/slot for reconciliation.

nodes.name: Validate acceptance
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Complete submission
nodes.notes: Release only workflow guard after committed accepted identity. Coding owns the separate durable task reservation.

parameters.content:
## 1. Acquire workflow guard

Shared fail-stop short interlock; no automatic expiry or error-release.

## 2. Read durable task state

Authenticated runner reads and complete GitHub history; unknown target or evidence stops.

## 3. Journal and apply effects

Intent before write; no blind POST replay. Exact marker/head/base and source readback.

## 4. Confirm and release

Reserve only acknowledges submission; collect releases durable slot only with stopped/publication proof. Owner reviews and manually imports matching artifacts.
